entities.name: 智能体 (agentic)
entities.how_described: 本集反复以「智能体产品」框架展开:任何智能体产品都逃不开质量、延迟、成本三个 KPI,而医疗在三者上都是困难模式;嘉宾领导 Abridge 的智能体体验团队。

evidence.quote: I specifically work on, lead our engineering teams for clinical decision support and our agentic experiences that the technology is now enabled and how we can bring that to healthcare.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So if you've ever worked on a agentic product before, regardless of vertical, the three KPIs that tend to matter are quality and latency and cost.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And it actually, I think it's funny that it really maps to the three KPIs that you care about in any agentic product.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.how_described: 本集嘉宾负责的产品主线:结合 EHR 数据、医患实时对话与医学文献/临床指南回答医生问题,属于高风险的前沿 AI 问题。

evidence.quote: I specifically work on, lead our engineering teams for clinical decision support and our agentic experiences that the technology is now enabled and how we can bring that to healthcare.

entities.name: 评估 (evals)
entities.how_described: 本集把 evals 说成「操作系统、公司的命脉」:先建内部基准做离线评估,再走 alpha→beta→A/B→持续监控的分阶段推出。

evidence.quote: For us, we really treat evals as the operating system, the life's blood of the company.

entities.name: LLM 评委 (LM judges)
entities.how_described: 本集说他们的做法是把临床医生的判断编码进专家校准的 LM judges,形成反馈闭环,让非医生的工程师也能快速迭代爬山;还包括临床安全 judge、边界与对抗 judge 等。

evidence.quote: How we do this is we always have expert calibrated LM judges.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So how can the rest of the company still move fast is by encoding that clinician judgment into LM judges.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 评分细则 (rubric)
entities.how_described: 本集说为绕开「生成器-验证器差距小」的死结,让相互独立的医生各自制定 rubric(列出好回答应包含的要素)、再由另一位医生仲裁、第四位临床医生做 QA,LLM 评委据此做语义匹配。

evidence.quote: We had independent physicians create a rubric.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So this rubric said elements of what we wanted in the response.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So it's not here's the exact response because, again, there's many infinite possible responses, but a good rubric elements that what a good response would look like.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And then we had a separate physician that actually adjudicated it, brought these two independent rubrics together, created a final rubric, and we actually had a fourth clinician do QA on these rubrics.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Once you have these rubrics, and here's a sample rubric what it looks like.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: You have a rubric of what are the elements that a response should look like.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Now we can actually have an LLM judge that compares our agents' responses to these rubric elements and does some basic semantic match to tell, hey, is our model performing well as we continue to hill climb whether it's our agent architecture, our models, or search ranking algorithms.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 后训练 (post-train)
entities.how_described: 本集说他们不是每个问题都用基础模型,而是把问题分解成更小的工作流,针对不同问题甚至病历不同章节后训练更小的模型,大幅降成本与延迟。

evidence.quote: So we actually post-train a lot of smaller models for different problems, such as different actually even to the granularity of different sections in the clinical node.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 前沿模型 (frontier model)
entities.how_described: 本集提出「制胜权」逻辑:拥有前沿实验室没有的数据、聚焦他们没聚焦的问题,就可能跑赢前沿模型的变化速度;质量已到顶的任务则训模型只为降本降延迟。

evidence.quote: But there are other problems where the quality isn't maxed out and people say, oh, the frontier model would just steamroll you.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Our key insight is we can actually potentially beat the rate of change on the frontier model if we have the right to win by having the right data that they may not have and the focus on a problem that they may not be focusing on.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
